sources.entry: reminal - Streams every window and terminal to any browser with input; software closed-lid mode keeps the Mac awake headlessly.

summary.one_liner: reminal is a tool that shares terminals and individual app windows (or the whole desktop) from one machine to any browser, with input control, via an outbound-only relay.
summary.what_it_does: Runs a session on your machine that viewers reach through a browser by session ID and PIN, or by scanning a QR code, with no open ports on the host. It provides a full terminal in the browser, live mirroring and remote control of individual app windows or the full desktop (H.264 up to 60 fps on macOS, JPEG on Windows, X11 on Linux), and sessions that survive disconnects. It includes closed-lid mode on macOS, which keeps the Mac awake and creates a virtual display when no monitor is attached. Other features include an owner-device mode for PIN-free access to your own machines, a `reminal machines` view across enrolled machines, an MCP server so AI agent CLIs can list and type into sessions, public HTTPS forwarding of local ports, and one-time-code file transfer between machines. The relay is Cloudflare Workers and can be self-hosted.
use_cases: remote access to a Mac or laptop from a phone or browser
keep a laptop serving with the lid closed and no monitor
share a terminal session with a teammate
mirror and control a remote GUI app window
expose a local dev server on a public HTTPS URL
copy files between machines without a cloud drive
let AI agents read or type into other terminal sessions
notable: Closed-lid mode on macOS disables clamshell sleep and auto-creates a virtual display so window mirroring works with the lid shut and nothing attached
Outbound-only design: the host dials out to a relay and opens no listening ports
Window frames stream peer-to-peer over WebRTC; the relay only routes end-to-end encrypted traffic
MCP server registers with many agent CLIs so agents can read and type into each other's sessions
Built-in public port forwarding (expose) that is PIN-gated by default
caveats: Closed-lid mode is macOS-only, and Linux window capture needs an X11 session (native Wayland is not supported)
Windows streaming uses the JPEG path at about 5-15 fps; the 60 fps H.264 pipeline is macOS-only
reminal expose traffic is not end-to-end encrypted and is readable by the relay
